mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the bending muscles was most worthwhile because the result explains how tendons attach muscle to bone and why a relaxed muscle cannot push the arm straight again.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the straightening muscles repeated the tendon explanation, though it usefully completed the opposing pair.

surprise.text: The explanation that relaxing a muscle only eases its pull clarified why a separate muscle group is needed to straighten the arm.
